Flight Phase

发动机启动

The action of starting aircraft engines, typically following ATC clearance. Communicated between flight crew and ground control before taxi or pushback.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is 发动机启动?

In this glossary, 发动机启动 refers to: The action of starting aircraft engines, typically following ATC clearance. Communicated between flight crew and ground control before taxi or pushback.

How is 发动机启动 used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "地面，阿联酋三四六号，请求在43号位启动发动机。"

Why does 发动机启动 matter in aviation?

发动机启动 matters because it supports clear communication in Flight Phase contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses 发动机启动?

发动机启动 is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

The action of starting aircraft engines, typically following ATC clearance. Communicated between flight crew and ground control before taxi or pushback.
